title: Core Admin Components — AdminDataTable, AdminStatCard, AdminPageHeader
content:
Create three reusable admin components extracted from inline patterns across admin pages.

## AdminDataTable — generic table shell
Extracted from patterns in dashboard, enrolments, courses, and users pages.
- Loading state: centered spinner skeleton
- Error state: AlertCircle icon + error message + Retry button
- Empty state: configurable emptyMessage
- Normal: wraps <section> + <div className="overflow-x-auto"> + <table> structure
- Props: { loading, error, onRetry, emptyMessage, columns, rows, keyExtractor }

## AdminStatCard — dashboard stat card
Extracted from the 4 inline stat cards in admin/page.tsx.
- Card with icon, label, value, optional trend arrow (up/down)
- Props: { icon: LucideIcon, label: string, value: string | number, trend?: number, trendUp?: boolean }

## AdminPageHeader — page title + back link + CTA
Extracted from courses/new, courses/edit, enrolments, dashboard, users pages.
- Consistent <header> with optional back link (<ArrowLeft>), title <h1>, optional CTA button
- Props: { title: string, backHref?: string, cta?: ReactNode }

Pure refactoring — no behavior change. No page modifications in this card.

evidence.residual: Pages will be refactored in AD-007-3 to use these components.

acceptance: AdminDataTable renders loading skeleton when loading=true
AdminDataTable shows error message + retry button when error prop is set
AdminDataTable displays emptyMessage when rows is empty
AdminDataTable renders table rows with provided columns and keyExtractor
AdminStatCard renders icon, label, value, and optional trend indicator
AdminPageHeader renders title, optional back link, and optional CTA
npm run typecheck && npm run lint pass
dependencies: AD-007 is the parent planning card.
verification: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && import and render each component in isolation to verify visual correctness.
